name: Color picker
description: A panel to pick any colour: a 2D saturation/brightness area with a crosshair handle, hue and alpha range sliders, a preview swatch, hex input, and preset swatches.

classes.ayy-color-picker: Panel container: flex column holding the 2D area, sliders, text input, and optional preset swatches.
classes.ayy-color-picker__area: 2D saturation and brightness gradient area with a crosshair handle; drag or use arrow keys to adjust saturation and value.
classes.ayy-color-picker__handle: Draggable crosshair pointer on the 2D area positioned by --_x and --_y.
classes.ayy-color-picker__sliders: Row containing the preview swatch and range sliders.
classes.ayy-color-picker__hue: Rainbow track range slider (0–360) controlling the hue.
classes.ayy-color-picker__alpha: Checkerboard and gradient track range slider (0–100) controlling opacity.
classes.ayy-color-picker__preview: Color swatch showing the currently picked colour over a transparency checkerboard.
classes.ayy-color-picker__inputs: Row holding the hex colour text input.
classes.ayy-color-picker__swatches: Row of preset colour swatch buttons.
classes.ayy-color-picker__swatch: One preset colour button inside the swatches row, coloured by --_swatch.

default.looks: A panel with the 2D saturation/brightness area, hue and alpha sliders, preview swatch, hex input, and preset swatches.

hover.looks: Swatches and slider thumbs scale up 10% on pointer hover.

pressed.none: No separate pressed look; the 2D area handle and slider thumbs follow the pointer smoothly while dragged.

focus.when: :focus-visible on the 2D area handle, range slider thumbs, text input, or preset swatch buttons
focus.looks: A 2px outline in --ayy-color-ring with a 2px offset.

disabled.looks: --ayy-opacity-disabled, controls cannot be dragged or typed into.

selected.looks: The active preset swatch gets a 2px surface gap and 2px text-colour ring; Highlight outline in High Contrast.

error.none: Color picker bounds clamp numerical and hex values; invalid typed hex codes are reverted on blur rather than leaving an error state.

loading.none: Color calculations are instant and local; no loading state.

sizes.density: Control heights and padding follow data-density: slider tracks and hex input scale from compact to comfortable and touch.
sizes.width: Panel inline-size (16rem / 256px), adapts up to 100% of its container.

js: colorPickerClass({ className? }) → string; connectColorPicker(root, { value?, alpha?, swatches?, onChange? }) → { setValue, update, destroy } wires the 2D area, sliders, hex input and preset swatches; hsvToRgb(hsv), rgbToHsv(rgb), rgbToHex(rgb), hexToRgb(hex) conversion functions.

element.description: Wraps an .ayy-color-picker: wires its 2D saturation/brightness area (pointer drag and arrow keys), hue and alpha sliders, hex input, and preset swatch buttons ([data-color]).

attributes.value: Hex colour code ("#2563eb"). Updated when the colour changes.
attributes.name: Form name: a hidden input inside carries the hex colour.

props.onValueChange: (color: string) => void — called when the colour changes
props.alpha: boolean — whether to show the alpha slider and allow opacity changes
props.swatches: string[] — list of preset colour hex codes

a11y: The 2D saturation/brightness area is a focusable role="slider" with aria-label, aria-valuetext, and arrow key navigation (Shift for 10% steps).
Hue and alpha sliders are native range inputs with accessible labels, keyboard stepped navigation, and Home/End support.
The hex input allows typing exact hex color codes with keyboard and screen reader support.
In Windows High Contrast mode, the panel, sliders, swatches, and handle keep clear outlines using CanvasText and Highlight system colors.
do: Use ColorPicker when people need to pick any custom colour or fine-tune hues, saturation, and transparency (e.g. in graphic design tools, theme customizers, or canvas drawing apps).
Provide preset swatches for common or brand-approved choices so users don't have to start from scratch.
Enable alpha only when transparency is supported by the underlying target.
dont: Don't use ColorPicker when users only choose between a small, fixed set of options — use Swatch or Segmented control instead.
Don't use ColorPicker for status or severity selection (e.g. error, warning) — use Badge or Select.
Don't hide what the color applies to — label the field with a clear label or preview.
